With a culture of recognition and reputation for excellence, ELS is the ideal organization in which to develop a long and successful career! ELS is hiring for the position of General Manager in Clermont, Florida. What you'll do: The General Manager is responsible the resources and assets of the property, including staff, buildings and more.

Your job will include: Provide exceptional customer service to ensure an excellent experience for our guests and residents. Ensure that the property is clean and attractive in order to maximize occupancy. Manage seasonal sales staff. Recruit, onboard and train top quality employees.

Engage guests and residents with daily, weekly and monthly activities and events. Partner with the marketing team to attract new residents and guests. Prepare, analyze and manage the operational budget of the property and improve profitability.

Experience & skills you need: Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 5+ years of resort or property management experience, preferably in a large manufactured housing, RV or multi-site setting. Experience working in an ancillary business, such as a golf course, restaurant and/or rental unit complex also helpful.

Experience managing a team of at least 50 employees. Sales and/or marketing experience preferred. Ability to produce financials and budgets, control expenses and identify opportunities to drive revenues. Understanding of the complex operational responsibilities associated with this role.

Experience with Microsoft Office and other web-based applications, including financial systems. Valid driver's license, good driving record and current auto insurance.

In return for your excellent skills and abilities, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental, and vision plans, a generous 401(k) employer match, and paid vacations, holidays, and sick time.

We invite you to visit our web site at www.equitylifestyleproperties.com for additional information regarding our exceptional resort communities. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and thank all applicants.

Role Description

You will act as the primary regional business partner for sales executives, supporting sales planning, territory and quota execution, forecast interpretation, operational improvements, and translation of strategic priorities into clear execution plans. You’ll drive process clarity, pipeline health, forecasting hygiene, and cross-functional governance, using AI and automation-enabled workflows to reduce manual reporting effort while maintaining strong human judgment over business recommendations.

· Drive operational excellence in account segmentation, territory planning, and execution, building the frameworks and analyses that guide how we assign and manage books of business .

· Support forecasting accuracy, pipeline health, and performance visibility through standardized reporting workflows, executive-ready insights, and continuous improvement of data quality and instrumentation.

· Own, scale, and uplevel Run-the-Business (RTB) processes that are critical to keeping Sales . running seamlessly—driving accuracy, speed, and continuous improvement.

· Lead cross-functional initiatives with teams, including Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, HR and Product to drive alignment and support decision-making.

· Own regional operating cadence, pipeline inspection, forecasting support, and performance reviews, using standardized templates and AI-assisted synthesis where appropriate.

· Partner with systems and data teams to automate recurring reporting, pipeline hygiene checks, manual workflow steps, and exception tracking.

· Analyze large datasets to identify trends and risks, validate AI- or dashboard-generated insights, and provide recommendations to improve sales performance and efficiency.

· Work with systems and data teams to enhance workflows, automate manual tasks, and drive efficiency across the Sales organization .

· Lead cross-functional issue resolution across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, HR, and Product, ensuring decisions are aligned and execution is clear. Primary business partner and strategic support for Global Sales Leaders. Collaborate with Sales leadership to develop and implement strategies to optimize sales performance .

· Primary point of contact for identifying sales improvements and coordinating solutions across GTM systems, Enablement, Reporting, Comp.

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

· 8 years of experience in management consulting, sales operations, business strategy, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or corporate advisory, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.

· 4 years of experience working with executive stakeholders.

· Experience using AI, automation, or analytics tools to improve forecasting, pipeline inspection, reporting, workflow efficiency, or sales operations decision support.

· Demonstrate ability to responsibly use AI or automation tools to synthesize data, improve operating workflows, and validate outputs before making business recommendations.

· Professional working proficiency in English is required as this role regularly collaborates with global team.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

· Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others .

· Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations .

· Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change .

· Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust .

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

The Payroll Operations Manager, Tax Payments will lead two complementary tax operations functions. The first is the Tax Operations payments team, responsible for the daily collection and payment of customer payroll taxes.

Secondly, this individual will oversee the Tax Health Check program, which deploys specialists to proactively assist customers in provisioning their tax deliverables — including Third Party Administrator linking and Tax ID registration — to resolve tax filing or payment blockers for customers.

The ideal candidate is a people-first leader who excels at building high-performing teams, establishing rigorous quality control, and driving continuous process improvement across multiple operational workstreams. This role is critical to ensuring Toast customers experience accurate, timely tax payments while measurably increasing the number of customers saved from compliance issues through proactive intervention.

· Manage, coach, mentor, and develop team members across the Tax Payments team and Tax Health Check program, fostering accountability and a culture of continuous improvement.

· Build and maintain quality control frameworks for the Tax Payments team, ensuring accurate and timely collection and payment of customer payroll taxes across all processing cycles.

· Drive standardization and disciplined execution of Tax Payments team processes, identifying and closing gaps in workflows to reduce error rates and improve throughput.

· Lead process improvement initiatives for the Tax Health Check program with the goal of increasing the volume of customers successfully provisioned and protected from negative tax filing or payment experiences.

· Oversee Tax Health Check specialists as they guide customers through TPA linking, Tax ID registration, and tax deliverable setup, ensuring a consistent and high-quality customer experience.

· Monitor workflow efficiency and audit operational performance across both functions; identify trends, surface risks, and implement corrective actions as needed.

· Build, maintain, and regularly present key performance indicators and OKR progress to stakeholders, including senior leadership.

· 7+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years of payroll tax experience

· 2+ years of people management or team leadership experience

· Demonstrated ability to build, document, and execute standardized operational processes

· Experience designing or operating quality control programs within a tax, payroll, or financial operations environment

· Track record of driving measurable process improvement outcomes

· Strong communication, interpersonal, and analytical skills with the ability to operate across all levels of the organization

· Solution-oriented with proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-paced, fluid environment
